summary:
We have created a bracelet that continuously monitors an astronaut's health.

We have improved the speed at which data is transmitted between the astronaut and the ground-based space center.

This addresses the challenge of ensuring the astronaut's safety from the moment they leave Earth until their return.

The project is crucial for safeguarding the astronaut in the event of any decline in their health.
details:
we made a bracelet consider( Esp32 mini , MAX30102 , MPU6050 ) which measures the heartrates and sp02 and temp and stability of the astronaut and send it to another esp32 in the Cabin by esp_now protocol the cabin which includes (LCD , SD card , SD card reader) and the LCD display the data to the astronaut and save the data in the SD card to use it will use it for calculations in the future and the esp in the cabin send data to another Esp in the Space Center by MQTT protocol (for the far data transmission)
we use hardware components and software
code languages : C++
Our team Mission is to help the astronaut before his health drop
